expectedIssues: Restaurant cover image failed to load
reportedIssues: The first card in the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) renders an empty grey block with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo, unlike the other cards which show artwork.

The heart/favorite button on the broken-image card uses a light grey circle with a grey outline icon, whereas the equivalent button on the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white icon — inconsistent styling and weaker contrast.

In the 'Popular right now' section the image block, title and metadata are not visually grouped into a bordered/elevated card as in the 'Fastest near you' row, making the broken grey area read as a page-level gap rather than part of a listing.
